levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Conversation covered only one category or stayed superficial.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Conversation covered all three categories (sleep, preventive check-ins, renewal reminders) at a general level.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Conversation identified a specific overdue or upcoming item in at least one category.

criteria.dimension: Specificity and checkability of the agreed change

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Change is vague and has no way to verify it happened.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Change names a specific action and frequency.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Change also names a specific, concrete way to check whether it's happening.

criteria.dimension: Reasoning about why routine care slips

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Reflection is generic ('I get busy') with no reasoning specific to routine care.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names a specific reason routine care, versus urgent problems, tends to get deprioritized.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Connects that reasoning to a specific safeguard built into the agreed change.

lookFors: No real health metric, diagnosis, or medication name is recorded anywhere in the response.
The agreed change names a specific, checkable action and frequency, not a vague intention.
Guardian confirmation is present alongside the learner's own account.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
